conditions.LL: original large prefix, full original pool; reuse
conditions.SS: original small prefix, original small pool; reuse
conditions.LS: original large prefix, original small pool; new
conditions.SL: original small prefix, full original pool; new

selection: All 25 source-A discordant pairs; 25 both-correct pairs sorted by large hash then small hash, unique large IDs.
primary: Strict-majority target repair and retention loss for both prefix effects and both pool effects; list all four cells.
limitations: Pool size, distractors and order change together

Retention uses existing labels, not a new source audit
training_gate: Original Stage C unchanged; this diagnostic alone never opens training.
